summary: Telefônica Brasil S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting that its Fiscal Council unanimously approved a proposal for the declaration of Interest on Capital (IoC) of R$500,000,000 gross (R$412,500,000 net of 17.5% withholding tax), equivalent to R$0.15646482856 per share gross. The record date is July 27, 2026, after which shares trade ex-IoC. Payment is due by April 30, 2027, and the amount will be allocated toward the mandatory minimum dividend for FY2026. The distribution mechanics depend on actual share count due to a concurrent buyback program. This is a predictable capital return to shareholders, with no special-situation event such as a tender or restructuring.
